name: wildvision-bench-internal
description: An internal visual-bench collection for evaluating vision model performance on a set of curated tasks (classification, detection, segmentation). It bundles multiple image-based tasks and metrics to benchmark model robustness and accuracy. The dataset appears intended for internal development and evaluation rather than broad public benchmarking.
evaluation_method: composite (accuracy for classification, mAP for detection, IoU/Dice for segmentation)
general_score_metric: composite_score (task-weighted combination of accuracy / mAP / IoU)
reputation: Internal benchmark with limited public visibility and adoption outside the hosting organization.
